test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1st December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them contains an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.

He had / prepare well / before the examination / so he did well.
solution:
The correct answer is '**prepare well'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The verb 'prepare' should be in the past participle form ('prepared') after 'had' to correctly form the past perfect tense.
 
• The past perfect tense is used to indicate that an action was completed (finished or "perfected") at some point in the past before something else happened. In this case, the action of preparing had been complete
d before the examination was faced,
 
• Thus, 'had prepared' instead of 'had prepare'.

 

Hence,** the correct answer** is, "He had prepared well before the examination, so he did well."
